description: How many directives the policy agent re-sent on its own, and how many the controller approved or rejected, in the last 60 minutes. Real traffic only.

configuration.query: FROM unstep-events | WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 60 minutes AND type IN ("ApprovedDirective", "RejectedDirective") | STATS decisions = COUNT(*) BY type, how = COALESCE(approved_via, rejected_via)
